# Copper Scroll Column 4 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 4 (treasure locations 13-16) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 4:1 — twin pools/double pools

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the twin pools" — literal shetei ha-berekot |
| LOGOS | "the double pools" — formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "the twin pools" — same as EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the twin pools" per EMET/PNEUMA majority. Both "twin" and "double" are valid for shetei; "twin" is more vivid.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 4:2 — in the floor / at the bottom

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in the floor of the basin" — literal |
| LOGOS | "in the floor of the basin" — same |
| PNEUMA | "at the bottom of the basin" — interpretive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "in the floor of the basin" per EMET/LOGOS. The Hebrew specifies the floor (qarqa), not the bottom generically.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 4:6 — stone structure/edifice/building

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the stone structure" — neutral |
| LOGOS | "the stone edifice" — elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "the stone building" — simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the stone structure" per EMET. "Edifice" overly elevates the register; "building" may imply more than the Hebrew indicates.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 4:9-10 — underground room/chamber/cellar + chamber/room/hall

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "underground room of the heave-offering chamber" |
| LOGOS | "underground chamber of the heave-offering room" |
| PNEUMA | "cellar beneath the heave-offering hall" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "underground chamber of the heave-offering room." "Chamber" for the underground space and "room" for the offering space avoids the tautology in EMET.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 4:13-14 — close by/nearby/not far away + portico/colonnade

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Close by, beneath the southern corner of the portico" |
| LOGOS | "Nearby, under the southern corner of the portico" |
| PNEUMA | "Not far away, under the south corner of the colonnade" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "Close by, beneath the southern corner of the portico" per EMET. "Portico" is standard for the Hebrew; PNEUMA's "colonnade" adds architectural specificity not warranted.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 4:15 — covered hall/roofed hall + pillar/column

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "beneath the pillar of the covered hall" |
| LOGOS | "beneath the pillar of the covered hall" — same |
| PNEUMA | "under the column of the roofed hall" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "beneath the pillar of the covered hall" per EMET/LOGOS. "Pillar" preferred over "column" for consistency with 3Q15 terminology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 4: 6*
